name: @sylphx/pdf-reader-mcp
description: Evidence-first PDF MCP. Published stable is 3.0.14 (TypeScript). Pure-Rust cutover is experimental/unpublished; 3.0.15–3.1.1 are withdrawn.
author: Sylphx <contact@sylphx.com> (https://sylphx.com)

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node && bun build src/doctor-cli.ts --outdir dist --target node && bun build src/legacy-engine-runtime.ts --outdir dist --target node && bun scripts/stage-pdfjs-worker.ts
scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run test
scripts.benchmark:all: bun run benchmark && bun run benchmark:quality && bun run benchmark:corpus && bun run benchmark:providers
scripts.benchmark:release-artifacts: MCP_PDF_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_DIR=${MCP_PDF_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_DIR:-benchmark-artifacts} MCP_PDF_PROVIDER_BENCHMARK_REQUIRED=true bun run benchmark:all && MCP_PDF_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_DIR=${MCP_PDF_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_DIR:-benchmark-artifacts} MCP_PDF_PROVIDER_MANIFEST=${MCP_PDF_PROVIDER_MANIFEST:-test/fixtures/provider-crop-manifest.json} MCP_PDF_PROVIDER_MANIFEST_CROP_REQUIRED=true bun run benchmark:provider-manifest-crops && MCP_PDF_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_DIR=${MCP_PDF_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_DIR:-benchmark-artifacts} MCP_PDF_PROVIDER_MANIFEST=${MCP_PDF_PROVIDER_MANIFEST:-test/fixtures/provider-analysis-manifest.json} MCP_PDF_PROVIDER_MANIFEST_REQUIRED=true bun run benchmark:provider-manifest
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run package:smoke
scripts.release:preflight: bun run typecheck && bun run check && bun run build && bun run package:smoke && bun run test:cov && bun run docs:build && bun run benchmark:release-artifacts && MCP_PDF_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_DIR=${MCP_PDF_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_DIR:-benchmark-artifacts} bun run benchmark:release-gate
scripts.release: echo "PUBLISH FREEZE: refusing release until capability parity is approved" && exit 1
scripts.build:rust: cargo build --release -p pdf-reader-core -p pdf-reader-cli -p pdf-reader-mcp-server && bun scripts/stage-rust-mcp.ts
scripts.validate:pure-rust-claimed: bun run check:pure-rust-matrix && bun run test:ts-vs-rust-text && bun run test:v3014-behavior-differential && bun run test:v3014-structure-differential && bun run test:v3014-text-layer-differential && bun run test:v3014-citation-chunk-differential && bun run test:v3014-semantic-hint-differential && bun run test:v3014-document-ast-differential && bun run test:v3014-document-map-differential && bun run test:v3014-trust-report-differential && cargo test -p pdf-reader-core --lib && cargo test -p pdf-reader-mcp-server --lib
